# Directory: extern

Purpose: Third-party single-file libraries embedded directly in the tree.

## Files
- `dr_wav.h`: Public-domain WAV decoder (reserved for future use when we switch from the bespoke WAV reader).

- `ebur128/`: pinned MIT libebur128 1.2.6, statically linked for private passage LUFS and true-peak capture; see its README and COPYING.
